query: WITH entities AS ((SELECT id FROM contacts WHERE partner_id = $1 AND COALESCE(partner_id = $2, $2 IS NULL) AND COALESCE(status = $3, $3 IS NULL) AND (id < $5) AND ($5 IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $4) UNION ALL (SELECT id FROM contacts WHERE partner_id = $1 AND COALESCE(partner_id = $2, $2 IS NULL) AND COALESCE(status = $3, $3 IS NULL) AND ($5 IS NULL) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $4) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $4) SELECT i.id AS "entity_id!: Repo__Id", e.sequence, e.event, CASE WHEN $6 THEN e.context ELSE NULL::jsonb END as "context: es_entity::ContextData", e.recorded_at, NULL::jsonb as "forgettable_payload?" FROM entities i JOIN contact_events e ON i.id = e.id ORDER BY i.id desc, i.id, e.sequence
